# Quantize (IEEE 754-2008 clause 5.3.2). The result has the fixed exponent
# Q(y) and the sign of x; the sign and coefficient of y are ignored. When
# the result coefficient would exceed Precision digits, or exactly one
# operand is an infinity, the result is NaN. The exponent is never
# adjusted, so there is no overflow or clamp class.

# --- Quantize64 ---

Quantize64 even exact 2.17 0.001 -> 2.170
Quantize64 even exact 2.17 0.01 -> 2.17
Quantize64 even exact 217 0.1 -> 217.0
Quantize64 even exact 217 1 -> 217
Quantize64 even exact 2.17 0.00 -> 2.17
Quantize64 even exact 1E+15 1 -> 1000000000000000
Quantize64 even exact 120 1E+1 -> 1.2E+2
Quantize64 even exact 1E+5 1 -> 100000
Quantize64 even exact 1E+5 1E+3 -> 1.00E+5
Quantize64 even exact -2.17 0.001 -> -2.170
Quantize64 even exact 2.17 -5.000 -> 2.170
Quantize64 even exact 1.5 1E-10 -> 1.5000000000
Quantize64 even exact 0.1 1E-10 -> 0.1000000000
Quantize64 even exact 1E+16 1E+1 -> 1.000000000000000E+16
Quantize64 down exact 2.17 0.001 -> 2.170
Quantize64 even exact 9.999999999999999E+384 1E+369 -> 9.999999999999999E+384
Quantize64 even exact 1.23456789E-390 1E-398 -> 1.23456789E-390
Quantize64 even exact 1 1.00E+2 -> 1
Quantize64 even exact 1 -1.00 -> 1.00
Quantize64 even exact 1234567890123456 1 -> 1234567890123456

Quantize64 even inexact 2.17 0.1 -> 2.2

Quantize64 down inexact -2.13 0.1 -> -2.2
Quantize64 zero inexact -2.17 0.1 -> -2.1

Quantize64 up inexact 0.001 0.01 -> 0.01
Quantize64 even inexact 1 1E+2 -> 0E+2
Quantize64 even inexact 123.456 1 -> 123
Quantize64 away inexact 123.456 1 -> 123

Quantize64 up inexact 123 1E+1 -> 1.3E+2
